title: It broke...
text: It broke.... I had one of these ...until it broke. The wood cracked and it died. no explanation, only a half dozen knives in it. I liked the idea though, so I just replaced it with a stainless steel-housed version. I still have it and I love it.

product_metadata.title: Mantello Knife Block- Universal Knife Holder- Bamboo Wood, Kitchen Knife Holder, Extra Large Knife Storage, Universal Knife Block, Knife Block Without Knives
features: Universal Fit- The versatile knife holder for kitchen counter lets you store any knife and utensil you want, with the unique flex rod system.
Extra Large- This universal XL knife block is extra large and can fit even more knives and utensils than our original small knife block.
Keep Knives Sharp- The kitchen knife holder is equipped with flexible rods that keep your knives sharp and prevent dulling with time.
Easy Wash- Flex rods on the kitchen knife storage block are removable and are top-rack dishwasher safe (no heat dry).
Overall Dimensions: Our knife storage block measures 10 1/2" H x 5 1/2" W x 7 1/2" D. **Knives not included**
